title: Wait, that’s not an option: LLMs Robustness with Incorrect Multiple-Choice Options

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models on multiple-choice questions where all provided options are incorrect to measure their tendency to blindly comply with instructions and select an invalid option rather than exercising reflective judgment.

Shuffling the order of multiple-choice options and averaging model accuracy across the different orderings to account for the tendency of models to select answers based on their position rather than their content.
Analyzing the selected incorrect options in arithmetic tasks to determine if models show a preference for answers that are numerically closer to the true correct value.
